g.text: Animations are separate local diagnostic trajectories. Benchmark expansion/time figures come from the original T4 run.
Left: a real 28-move explored branch, with a provably trapped box. A* can explore and backtrack through many other branches.
Right: a verified 55-move solution from the risk-aware diagnostic. No claim is made that this proves the uncertainty mechanism.
